page.content:
Wife who burns the letters, survives Hamilton, and asks who tells his story.

How Eliza Schuyler Hamilton connects

  • Faction: the Schuyler sisters — Eliza is the sister who marries Hamilton.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Eliza marries Hamilton and outlives him to tell the story.
  • Character: Phillipa Soo — Phillipa Soo originated Eliza Schuyler.
  • Character: Philip Hamilton — Philip is Eliza and Alexander's son.

What is Eliza Schuyler Hamilton?

Eliza Schuyler is the sister who marries Hamilton, bears Philip, burns the correspondence after the Reynolds pamphlet, and closes the musical by outliving everyone and founding the orphan story.

Key threads lead to the Schuyler sisters, Alexander Hamilton, Phillipa Soo and Philip Hamilton.
